name: Executive order of July 1, 1874 setting apart the San Xavier reservation for the Papago (Tohono O'odham)
promises: Not a cession: the President set apart a reservation around San Xavier del Bac in T. 15 and 16 S., R. 12 and 13 E., by the courses Royce gives (Royce p. 876, area 572).
landTaken: None by this order; it set the reservation apart.
today: In the Papago land claim (Docket 345) the Indian Claims Commission found in 1968 that the Papago Tribe held original Indian title to its claimed area but excluded the San Xavier del Bac and Papago reservations from the area to be valued; the claim concerned the land outside them.
